title: Accept 10400035: Finite-type invariants on free-exterior string links: low-degree restrictions and an order-seven example
body:
## Accepted result and published preprint **Finite-type invariants on free-exterior string links: low-degree restrictions and an order-seven example**, Alec Kriebel. Published paper and verification package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23430498 (https://zenodo.org/records/23430498).

This unrefereed, extensively AI-assisted application note studies ordinary unframed smooth ordered string links with fixed boundary and upward orientation; upward does not impose height monotonicity. Invariants are rational and freeness concerns the actual three-dimensional exterior group, abstractly the free group of rank k, without a primitive-meridian condition.

The entire all-length repeated-index Milnor algebra intersected with the two-strand order-at-most-two space is recalled as the span of 1, linking, and linking squared, a filtered Habegger–Masbaum corollary. Applications of Meilhan’s complete classification and prior free tangles show that a component Conway coefficient is outside the Milnor-plus-vanishing span at (k,n)=(2,2), and that the vanishing kernel is zero for all k≥2 and 0≤n≤2. Exact marked genus-two reversal, combined with the prior Duzhin–Karev ordinary detector, gives an existential nonzero kernel invariant of exact ordinary order seven on two strands, hence nonzero kernels for every n≥7.

The wheel is credited to Bar-Natan following Duzhin–Karev’s journal proof. Known tangle examples, rational 3/2 geometry, classical genus-two machinery, and Hatcher’s relative-ball theorem are credited in the manuscript. Historical priority of the combined applications is undetermined; no firstness or new detector is claimed. Orders three through six, least positive kernel order, and higher-order classification are unaddressed by this work. Morimoto (1995) and Li (2009) remain unread priority leads and are not mathematical dependencies.

AI was used extensively in solving, verification, source investigation, and writing. Internal AI audits are not conventional human peer review or formal certification. New finite arithmetic programs in the supporting kit provide supplementary stage evidence, not full theorem proof; the unchanged original edition is theoretical and delivered no executable replay. No numeric value of the existential invariant on a named nonsingular link is supplied.

## Accepted scope and review Complete negative Milnor/free-exterior spanning answer at (k,n)=(2,2); N_n(k)=0 for k>=2,n<=2; existential exact-order-seven nonzero element in N_7(2). Two-strand orders 3..6, higher-strand higher-order kernels, least order and general classification remain unresolved. The result is accepted at the exact audited head `86d076dae3e3fa8b7cda7fd9c6a822c3d7392c14`. 2 fresh independent complete AI whole-package reviews were completed, with the final review finding zero actionable issues. Subsequent bounded administrative adoption is recorded in the current external ROOT final seal; earlier status/counter/hold fields remain dated history. Prior mathematical results and proof dependencies are credited. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness are unestablished. AI tools were used extensively; this is an unrefereed preprint, without conventional human peer review or formal proof certification. The repository Zenodo uploader verified the exact reviewed metadata and PDF/support bytes. The Google Workspace CLI recorded the DOI/details in the requested tracker with exact read-back. No GitHub release is created. Current audit and publication receipts: `audits/pr1034_10400035`.
Preserved original PR description: dated submission history ## Results This draft collects three independently audited results for Stanford Question 2.13 (10400035 / AMR-103-0035), in the ordinary unframed smooth ordered fixed-endpoint rational string-link category: 1. The Milnor/free-exterior span fails at (k,n)=(2,2). The intersection with the entire all-length repeated-index Milnor algebra is span_Q{1, linking, linking²}; the first component Conway coefficient is outside M_2(2)+N_2(2). 2. N_n(k)=0 for every k≥2 and 0≤n≤2. 3. N_7(2) contains a nonzero invariant of exact order seven, hence N_n(2)≠0 for every n≥7. The third proof includes the complete marked free-reversal lemma, with exact outer-boundary agreement, collar correction, tube filling, and relative-ball isotopy. It then uses the ordinary rational Duzhin–Karev v5 theorem and weight-system integration. The result is existential; no named nonsingular-link numeric value is claimed. ## Evidence and attribution The package preserves all authored mathematics in the three full proofs, four supporting lemmas, three independent whole-proof audits, the separate written algebra audit, and two bounded literature/context reviews. Only documented provenance/privacy and unavailable-artifact edits are made. The original source reports are unchanged. Principal established ingredients are Meilhan’s ordinary degree-two classification; repeated-index Milnor concordance invariance; Nogueira’s free tangle; Kauffman–Lambropoulou’s rational-tangle construction; Willerton’s Conway normalization; classical genus-two hyperelliptic extension/centrality; Hatcher’s relative-ball theorem; and Duzhin–Karev’s ordinary unframed rational degree-seven orientation detector. Public citations, exact editions, access limits, and historical inspection records are retained. These are AI mathematical audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification. No novelty or earliest-priority claim is made. ## Theoretical edition and remaining scope No executable scripts, fixtures, computational result files, or logs are included. Historical computational passages remain identified as supplementary prior-audit accounts, not checks rerun for this edition. Existing mathematical calculations, including the degree-seven trace polynomial and integer-matrix example, are preserved as authored exposition. No executable check was rewritten into prose to replace an omitted artifact. Orders three through six on two strands remain unresolved, as do general higher-strand higher-order kernels and general classifications. There is no least-order claim or extension of the order-two spanning failure to all larger orders. The campaign stopped after 3 of 5 approaches; two remain unused and no further approach was spent on packaging. ## Exact file scope Add only the nineteen files listed below under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10400035/. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file is changed. No copied third-party source body, dataset content, private source, private coordination material, or mixed private artifact inventory is included. SOURCES.json records sixteen public PDF identities locally rechecked for this edition, without source bodies.
